notes.title: Farmer's Father: Story Update Traitor
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42643366/0d4070c5acd540e1be9a9d2ced7f96166d922415.png
Dear fellow folks,

We write to you with a heavy heart and a sense of urgency. It has come to our attention that there's someone among us who's betrayed our community.

In these troubling times, we must remain watchful and united. Our village has faced unimaginable hardships. Villagers are suffering as the sound of gunshots echoes through the air, and families fear for their loved ones who have been taken away to prison camps, their fate unknown.

Our brave resistance fighters, with unwavering courage, continue to stand tall in the face of adversity, protecting us and striving to restore peace to our beloved Zalesie. But as we fight for our freedom, we cannot ignore the traitorous act that threatens to undermine our struggle.

We may not know all the details, but we can't let this betrayal break us. The very fabric of our community is at stake, and we must rally together to protect one another and ensure that justice prevails.

Let us find strength in each other's support and remain resolute in our determination to overcome these dark times. As one, we will face the challenges ahead with bravery and hope.

Together, we will not waver. We will not back down. We will keep fighting back until our town is free from the shadow of treachery.

In these darkest of hours, we must remember that we are a community bonded by shared values and history. Let us hold each other close and stand as a beacon of hope, guiding our way to a brighter future.

With hearts full of solidarity and a commitment to our cause, we press forward, knowing that the light of justice and unity will shine upon us once more.

If you've noticed anything suspicious or have any information, please don't hesitate to share it with resistance. Your help might be the key to keeping our town safe.

With solidarity and hope,
X

[previewyoutube=viOBb9nMMtI;full][/previewyoutube]

 introduced new characters to enrich the storyline and enhance the player's experience.
 fixed character movement issues, eliminating soldier spinning and ensuring NPCs rotate correctly.

 upgraded soldier AI with better responsiveness and improved listening abilities.
 added more valuable chests with necessary items for player progression.
Let us know how you like the newest update!

Dear Friends! 

We are very happy to announce, we've prepared for you a HUUUUGE UPDATE ːsteamhappyː
For many days, we have been reading your comments and suggestions and hopefully many new changes we've provided with this patch will fullfill some of your requests!
